name: Voidek SERP Schema Builder
author: Voidek Webolutions

sections.description:
Voidek SERP Schema Builder is a lightweight WordPress plugin that helps search engines and AI systems understand your content by adding structured data (JSON-LD) for:

  • Product schema (stars, price, author, etc)
  • Review schema (rating, reviewBody, reviewer, bestRating/worstRating)
  • Article schema (headline, author, datePublished, dateModified, image, publisher)

Why use it?

  • Improves eligibility for rich results (stars, price, author, etc.) which often increases click-through rates.
  • Makes content machine-readable so modern AI Models/LLMs can use your exact page facts when answering queries.

Features

  • Dynamic Product Data Integration
  • Support for Product Variations
  • Automatic Stock Availability Updates
  • Multiple Product Images in Schema
  • Aggregate Ratings and Reviews
  • Property selectivity in the admin dashboard
  • Dynamic generation of schema
  • Admin control of schema topics

Source Code

This plugin doesn’t use any build tools (such as npm, composer, webpack) to generate its production code. The plugin includes minified JavaScript and CSS for production use.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings in the WordPress Admin.
sections.faq:
What is schema markup and why is it important?

Schema markup (schema.org) is a standardized vocabulary that helps machines understand the meaning of your content. Proper schema increases the chance your pages qualify for rich snippets and provides clearer signals to search engines and AI systems.

How does this plugin improve SEO?

By providing accurate JSON-LD structured data, your pages become eligible for enhanced search results (ratings, price, etc.). This often increases visibility and click-through rates. Structured data also makes your content easier to index and interpret.

How do AI Models/LLMs use schema data?

AI Models/LLMs prefer machine-readable facts. Schema provides exact values (e.g., product price, average rating) which AI models can use to answer questions with higher accuracy and cite precise information from your pages.

Is the plugin compatible with Yoast or Rank Math?

Yes. The plugin outputs standard JSON-LD and is designed to coexist with major SEO plugins. If multiple plugins output the same schema type, configure them to avoid duplication.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin injects compact JSON-LD scripts into your pages and avoids heavy assets or extra database queries.
